property_summary: The reverted status of mintSynth depends solely on the caller being a curated pool, and never on the internal LP balance calculation.
mintSynth never reverts when called by a curated pool, regardless of the added LP amount.
mintSynth never reverts when called by a curated pool

After any sequence of calls that includes mintSynth, the sum over all pools of mapSynth_LPBalance must equal the sum over all pools of mapSynth_LPDebt (adjusted for LP units) whenever the pool's LP balance is tracked, but the buggy assignment overwrites previously accumulated LP balance instead of adding, causing the tracked LP balance to be lower than it should be for some pool after at least two mints from the same pool.

After any two mintSynth calls from the same pool, the buggy assignment overwrites the previous LP balance instead of adding, causing mapSynth_LPBalance[pool] to be less than the sum of all lpUnits received from that pool.

After any two mintSynth calls from the same curated pool, the tracked mapSynth_LPBalance for that pool must equal the sum of the individual lpUnits received, but the buggy assignment overwrites the previous balance instead of accumulating, causing it to equal only the latest lpUnits.
